Quarterly statements and annual analyst EPS estimates come from FMP; daily bars and latest trades come from Alpaca. Only stocks with a verified market cap from $3B through $10B are included in discovery and sector-average calculations. FY1 is the current, not-yet-completed fiscal year; its EPS-growth baseline is the prior reported FY0 EPS when available. FY2 growth compares FY2 and FY1 forward EPS. Missing values may use FMP forwardPE or same-sector analyst-estimate statistics. Reported quarterly LTM data is a separate backward-looking recovery validation and is not used to calculate forward EPS. Missing volume data disables only the volume-expansion gate. Missing quarterly statements remain excluded: P/E ratios cannot reconstruct reported revenue, EBITDA, or LTM recovery.
